full_description: FitnessPal Lite is a simplified fitness tracking app designed to help users monitor their exercise and nutrition. With basic calorie tracking and workout logging, you can easily stay on top of your fitness goals. Track your daily food intake and macronutrients, and log your workouts to see progress over time. Whether you're a beginner or an experienced athlete, FitnessPal Lite provides a straightforward and easy-to-use interface to help you achieve your health and wellness objectives.
